briefing.text: Rockstar says GTA VI made $3.79 billion in day-one retail sales.
Anthropic shares fell near their $83 IPO price on their second day of trading.
The Hunger Games prequel took $21 million in previews and eyes a $110 million start.
California's attorney general subpoenaed Nvidia over whether chips reached China.
Apple is reportedly building an AI agent that can control Mac apps and write code.

stories.title: GTA VI makes $3.79 billion on day one, Rockstar says
stories.summary: Rockstar says Grand Theft Auto VI took $3.79 billion in first-day worldwide retail sales, and 32.5 million copies were pre-sold.
stories.why: It is one of the biggest entertainment launches ever, and a test for the whole console market.
stories.happened: Sensor Tower had estimated about $2.36 billion. GamesRadar compares the launch with $800 million for GTA V and $725 million for Red Dead Redemption 2. The game also holds a 99 on Metacritic.
stories.next: Watch for Take-Two's next update on sales and any news on a PC version.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The day-one figure beats GTA V's launch several times over.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Fans waited 13 years since GTA V.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Its 99 on Metacritic ties the highest score the site lists.

stories.background: Rockstar Games is owned by Take-Two Interactive and also made Red Dead Redemption.

meme.bottom: for a game about doing crimes for money
meme.take: GTA VI earns in one day what its characters spend a whole campaign trying to steal.

stories.title: Sunrise on the Reaping heads for a $110 million opening, Deadline says
stories.summary: The Hunger Games prequel took $21 million in previews and is tracking toward about $110 million, which would be the series' fourth best start.
stories.why: A strong debut would show book-based franchises can still fill cinemas in a crowded holiday season.
stories.happened: The $21 million includes $5 million from Wednesday early screenings, second only to Catching Fire's preview start in the series. It is on about 3,900 US screens with 76% on Rotten Tomatoes. Deadline puts its early global tally at $76 million.
stories.next: Watch for Sunday's official opening numbers and how it holds over Thanksgiving week.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The previews were the series' second best.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Jennifer Lawrence, Josh Hutcherson and Woody Harrelson are said to have cameos.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It opens the week before Thanksgiving, a strong window for long runs.

stories.background: The Hunger Games films are based on Suzanne Collins' novels. This is the second prequel, following a young Haymitch Abernathy.

meme.top: A film about a deadly televised contest
meme.take: The Hunger Games returns to cinemas, which are once again fighting to survive the weekend.

stories.title: Anthropic shares give back most of their debut gains on day two
stories.summary: After closing its first day at $97.17, Anthropic stock fell about 13.5% midday on November 20 to just above $84, near its $83 IPO price.
stories.why: It is the biggest test yet of how public markets value a frontier AI lab.
stories.happened: Shares opened at $111.50 on November 19 before closing at $97.17. Bloomberg tied a post-market drop to reports of Apple's own AI agent plans. The FT reports SoftBank fell about 15% and TSMC more than 5% as Asian tech stocks sold off.
stories.next: Watch for how the stock trades against its $83 IPO price next week.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The IPO was described as the largest US listing on record.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Bloomberg linked a share drop to reports of Apple building its own AI agent.

drivers.label: Ripple effect
drivers.text: Asian chip and tech stocks such as SoftBank and TSMC fell the next day.

stories.background: Anthropic is the San Francisco AI company behind the Claude models. It listed on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT.

meme.bottom: now trading at roughly the IPO
meme.take: Anthropic shares take a round trip and come home with a souvenir of one dollar.

stories.title: Apple is said to be building an AI agent that can run your Mac
stories.summary: Bloomberg reports Apple is working on an agent that could control Mac apps, browse the web and write code, based on a job listing it later removed.
stories.why: Apple has been seen as behind in AI, and an agent that runs the whole computer would put it in the race directly.
stories.happened: The listing for a senior engineering manager described an agent that runs command-line tools and coordinates subagents. Apple pulled it after the report. Apple is also said to be preparing extra permission warnings for rival agents.
stories.next: Watch for whether Apple shows any agent features at its next software event.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Apple has not announced the product, so every detail comes from the listing.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Google gave Gemini control of Macs the same day.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Computer-using agents are the current race among AI companies.

stories.background: Apple makes the iPhone and Mac and launched its Apple Intelligence features in 2024.

meme.bottom: the agent would have done it faster
meme.take: Apple's secret AI agent was revealed by the one thing agents cannot hide from: recruiting.

stories.title: California's attorney general subpoenas Nvidia over chips and China
stories.summary: AG Rob Bonta served Nvidia with an investigative subpoena asking whether advanced chips or confidential information reached China.
stories.why: Nvidia is the most important AI chip company, and its China dealings are already under heavy scrutiny.
stories.happened: The subpoena also asks whether Nvidia misled investors and covers former CEO Jensen Huang. No wrongdoing has been established. Huang is due at congressional interviews on December 1, with Nvidia's general counsel the next day.
stories.next: Watch for Huang's congressional interview on December 1.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Nvidia is one of the world's most valuable companies.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows Huang's resignation as CEO on November 12.

drivers.label: Rules
drivers.text: China chip access is a top US policy issue.

stories.background: Nvidia designs the GPUs used to train and run most AI models. It is based in Santa Clara, California.

meme.take: Nvidia has an interim CEO, a board, and now a subpoena. The org chart keeps growing.

stories.title: EU Commission confirms a cyberattack that used an AI hacking tool
stories.summary: The European Commission says attackers disrupted its systems for over 10 days, and CERT-EU says they used an AI penetration-testing tool named ARTEX.
stories.why: It is one of the first confirmed cases of an AI-assisted attack hitting a major government body.
stories.happened: Staff payroll and medical reimbursement systems were temporarily affected, The Register reports. Officials were checking whether personal data was taken. Politico reports the Commission confirmed the attack and CERT-EU named the tool.
stories.next: Watch for the Commission's findings on whether any personal data was compromised.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: An AI testing tool was named as part of an attack on an EU institution.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Payroll and medical claims systems for staff were disrupted.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Disruption lasted more than 10 days, Politico reports.

stories.background: The European Commission is the executive arm of the European Union. CERT-EU is its cybersecurity response team.

meme.take: Security tools are meant to find the holes. This one apparently kept going.

stories.title: Twitch calls GTA VI its largest game launch ever
stories.summary: Twitch says GTA VI was its biggest game launch, with 3.3 million viewers at once, Bloomberg reports. StreamCharts counted nearly 8 million in all.
stories.why: Live viewing numbers show how much of the internet stopped to watch one game come out.
stories.happened: StreamCharts' estimate covered five platforms. Riot Games said Valorant's 1.7 million viewer Twitch record had been broken. GamesRadar reports one streamer finished the game in under 40 hours without a break.
stories.next: Watch for whether viewing holds up once the story has been widely seen.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Twitch counted 3.3 million viewers at once, Bloomberg reports.

drivers.label: Record
drivers.text: It beat Valorant's previous Twitch record.

drivers.label: Stamina
drivers.text: A streamer stayed up over 50 hours for a sub-40 hour run.

stories.background: Twitch is Amazon's live-streaming platform, used mostly for gaming.

meme.bottom: someone else play the game they bought
meme.take: GTA VI broke streaming records, mostly among people who also own GTA VI.

stories.title: Meta's Muse AI reportedly mixed up users' private conversations
stories.summary: After reports it read Signal messages, TechCrunch reports Meta's Muse agent also showed employees other people's childcare messages and bank balances.
stories.why: An assistant that sees your notifications and chats only works if it keeps everyone's data separate.
stories.happened: According to the report, staff testing Muse saw unfamiliar personal reminders and financial details. Meta said employees test versions with features the public does not have. Earlier reports said Muse could read Signal messages on Android via notifications.
stories.next: Watch for Meta to say whether public users were affected and what it has changed.

drivers.label: Privacy
drivers.text: The reports involve encrypted chats and bank balances.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Meta runs Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp.

drivers.label: Momentum
drivers.text: It is the second Muse privacy report in two days.

stories.background: Meta owns Facebook, Instagram and WhatsApp. Signal is a nonprofit encrypted messaging app.

meme.take: Muse was meant to know you well. It reportedly got to know your neighbours too.

stories.title: NGINX fixes ten flaws, including bugs that could let attackers run commands
stories.summary: Researchers disclosed ten NGINX flaws, five of them memory-corruption bugs dubbed nginx2root, and F5 has released fixes.
stories.why: NGINX runs a large share of the world's websites, so a flaw in it affects huge numbers of servers.
stories.happened: Unauthenticated attackers could crash NGINX or, in some setups, run commands. A separate Linux kernel flaw could allow escalation to root. Fixes came on November 18. Cloudflare said exploitation had not been confirmed as of November 20.
stories.next: Watch for signs of attacks in the wild and patch adoption rates.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: NGINX is one of the most used web servers.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Some flaws can be triggered without logging in.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Fixes are out, so the race is on to patch.

stories.background: NGINX is open-source web server software, owned by F5 since 2019.

meme.top: Half the internet runs on NGINX
meme.bottom: the other half is patching it
meme.take: NGINX gets ten fixes at once, and server admins get a weekend plan.

stories.title: Intuit agrees to sell Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion
stories.summary: Intuit is selling email marketing service Mailchimp to Bending Spoons for $3.68 billion in cash and stock, CNBC reports.
stories.why: Intuit paid $12 billion for Mailchimp in 2021, so the price shows how far its value has fallen.
stories.happened: The deal is in cash and stock. Bending Spoons is known for buying established apps and services and restructuring them.
stories.next: Watch for what Bending Spoons changes at Mailchimp once the deal closes.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The price is less than a third of what Intuit paid.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Mailchimp is one of the best-known email tools for small business.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Bending Spoons keeps buying well-known software brands.

stories.background: Intuit makes TurboTax and QuickBooks. Bending Spoons is an Italian tech company that has bought Evernote and Vimeo.

meme.take: Intuit sells Mailchimp, a rare tax lesson from the maker of TurboTax.

stories.title: Signal adds a setting to block AI assistants from reading chats
stories.summary: Signal restricts screenshots in its iOS app and adds a Block Siri AI setting that is on by default, with Android protections where possible.
stories.why: As AI assistants gain access to screens and notifications, private chats are at risk of being read.
stories.happened: Signal says the protections are incomplete and has asked Apple, Google and Microsoft for proper developer controls. It comes days after reports that Meta's Muse could read Signal messages through Android notifications.
stories.next: Watch for whether Apple, Google or Microsoft add the controls Signal asked for.

drivers.label: Privacy
drivers.text: Signal is built around keeping chats private.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It follows the Meta Muse reports.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI agents increasingly see what is on screen.

stories.background: Signal is a nonprofit encrypted messaging app used by journalists, activists and governments.

meme.bottom: around your chats and the AI
meme.take: Signal now protects your messages from spies, hackers and your own phone's assistant.

stories.title: Trump says US firms building AI data centers abroad could face taxes
stories.summary: President Trump said at a White House news conference that companies building AI facilities overseas could face substantial taxes or restrictions.
stories.why: Big tech firms are spending heavily on data centers worldwide, so any penalty would reshape where they build.
stories.happened: No rates, legislation or timeline were given, so it is a stated threat rather than a policy. The remark comes as US rules already limit remote access to advanced chips by Chinese companies.
stories.next: Watch for any written proposal or executive order with actual terms.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: AI data center spending runs into the hundreds of billions of dollars.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: No details were given, which leaves companies guessing.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI infrastructure has become a trade and policy issue.

stories.background: AI companies rent or build huge data centers full of chips to train and run their models.

meme.top: Build your AI data center abroad
meme.take: The new data center policy has everything except numbers, rules and a date.

stories.title: Valve drops Steam Machine waitlists, blaming memory and storage costs
stories.summary: Valve says it will stop running Steam Machine waitlists because it does not know how many it can make or what they will cost.
stories.why: Rising memory prices are now hitting gaming hardware, which could make PCs and consoles pricier.
stories.happened: The Steam Machine can now be ordered without a reservation, GamesRadar reports, but the 2TB model could see further price rises in the new year. Valve pointed to memory and storage costs.
stories.next: Watch for a price change on the 2TB model in January.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Memory and storage costs have climbed sharply.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Waitlists were set up because demand was high.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Valve says it cannot predict supply or price.

stories.background: Valve runs Steam, the biggest PC games store, and makes the Steam Deck handheld.

meme.bottom: because no one knows the price
meme.take: Valve makes the Steam Machine easier to order and harder to budget for.

stories.title: Google's Gemini can now use apps on your Mac to finish tasks
stories.summary: Gemini for Mac can now operate apps, files and websites in the background, with a live preview and per-app permissions.
stories.why: It puts Google's agent on Apple's computers before Apple ships its own.
stories.happened: The feature is for US Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers, in English at first, TechCrunch reports. It arrived the same day Bloomberg reported Apple is building its own Mac-controlling agent.
stories.next: Watch for a wider rollout and for how Apple handles third-party agents on the Mac.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Apple is reportedly building a competing agent.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Computer-using agents are spreading fast.

drivers.label: Access
drivers.text: It works across local files and apps, not just the web.

stories.background: Gemini is Google's AI assistant. Apple silicon Macs use Apple's own M-series chips.

meme.take: Gemini moves into the Mac and is already rearranging the furniture.

stories.title: Google picks Blue Origin to launch its AI server satellites in 2029
stories.summary: Google chose Blue Origin's New Glenn for a dedicated launch of TPU-equipped satellites for Project Suncatcher, targeting early 2029.
stories.why: Putting AI computers in orbit is a bet that solar power in space can ease the energy crunch on Earth.
stories.happened: Each satellite is meant to offer roughly a data center rack's worth of compute, powered by the sun, in a sun-synchronous orbit. The Verge reports a Q1 2029 target. Commercial viability has not yet been shown.
stories.next: Watch for test results and the cost estimates Google shares before launch.

drivers.label: First of its kind
drivers.text: A dedicated launch for AI compute satellites has not been done before.

drivers.label: Power
drivers.text: Data centers' electricity use is a growing problem.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Blue Origin is Jeff Bezos's rocket company.

stories.background: TPUs are Google's own AI chips. New Glenn is Blue Origin's heavy-lift rocket.

meme.top: Data centers ran out of land
meme.bottom: so Google is trying the sky
meme.take: Google's plan for AI's power problem is to move it somewhere with more sun and no neighbours.

stories.title: Over 500 Google workers ask for an AI-free Search option for schools
stories.summary: More than 500 Google employees urged bosses to let schools keep traditional Search without AI, Bloomberg reports, after big districts weighed leaving.
stories.why: Schools are a huge market for Google, and AI in classrooms is a sensitive topic for parents.
stories.happened: Google had said schools that opt out of its Gemini-powered features would lose Search. The New York Times reported that New York City, Los Angeles and Chicago districts were looking at alternatives. Now staff have pushed back too.
stories.next: Watch for whether Google changes its school Search policy.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The districts involved are three of the largest in the US.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Employees have joined schools in pushing back.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI in education is a live debate.

stories.background: Google's tools, including Chromebooks and Classroom, are widely used in US schools.

meme.bottom: now Google's staff are asking too
meme.take: Google is learning that the hardest audience for AI is a school board.

stories.title: Yellowjackets begins its final season on Paramount+
stories.summary: The fourth and final 10-episode season of Yellowjackets premiered on November 20, with the finale set for January 22, 2027, Forbes reports.
stories.why: The survival drama built one of streaming's most devoted fan bases, who now want answers.
stories.happened: It leads a busy streaming weekend that also includes Percy Jackson season 3 on Disney+ and Hulu and Netflix's The Altruists, about the FTX collapse. Forbes lists the Rings of Power season 3 finale as moved up to November 24.
stories.next: Watch for how the final season handles the show's long-running mysteries.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: The show has a large, theory-hungry audience.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Its run will stretch across the holidays into January.

drivers.label: Finale
drivers.text: It is the last season, so this is the end of the story.

stories.background: Yellowjackets follows a girls' soccer team stranded in the wilderness after a plane crash, and their lives 25 years later.

meme.take: Yellowjackets has ten weeks to explain everything, which is roughly one mystery per episode.

stories.title: Ubisoft is down 1,100 staff in six months as it launches an AI subsidiary
stories.summary: After cutting 166 more jobs in Montreal and Quebec City, Ubisoft is down about 1,100 staff in six months and has set up an AI unit called Motherbrain.
stories.why: Players and developers worry big publishers are swapping people for AI tools.
stories.happened: GamesRadar reports Motherbrain focuses on AI for gameplay. Ubisoft also says Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced is among the most successful action-adventure remakes, and that Nolan's The Odyssey helped AC Odyssey sales.
stories.next: Watch for what Motherbrain actually ships and whether more cuts follow.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Job cuts and AI investment are arriving together.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: About 1,100 jobs have gone in six months, GamesRadar says.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Several publishers are betting on generative AI.

stories.background: Ubisoft is a French publisher behind Assassin's Creed and Far Cry.

meme.take: Ubisoft named its AI unit Motherbrain, which is what people call the boss in games.

stats.label: staff cut in six months, reported

stories.title: Hackers exploit a critical Cisco Expressway flaw rated 9.8
stories.summary: Security firm F6 reports attackers used a Cisco Expressway flaw that lets unauthenticated users run commands as root, after a public exploit appeared.
stories.why: Expressway handles video and voice calls for many large organizations, so a flaw opens a door into company networks.
stories.happened: F6 says attackers broke into two internet-facing devices and two cluster nodes, then moved deeper, stealing credentials via GitLab. Cisco released patches on October 21. The attackers' scripts may have been AI-assisted.
stories.next: Watch for more victims and for organizations that have not yet patched.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Attackers can run commands as root without logging in.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Expressway is widely used by large organizations.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: The scripts may have been written with AI help.

stories.background: Cisco is a major maker of networking equipment. Expressway connects video conferencing systems.

meme.top: The patch came out in October
meme.take: Cisco fixed it a month ago. Some attackers read the patch notes more closely than the targets.

stories.title: European streamer SkyShowtime will shut down at the end of 2027
stories.summary: SkyShowtime, a joint venture of Comcast's Sky and Paramount Skydance, will close at the end of 2027, with its CEO leaving, Deadline reports.
stories.why: It is a sign that mid-size streamers are struggling to compete with global giants.
stories.happened: CEO Monty Sarhan exits and CFO Mark Neil becomes interim general manager. A letter from the board cites the challenge of scale against global streamers. Showtime content is being folded into the Paramount+ brand.
stories.next: Watch for where SkyShowtime's shows go and what subscribers are offered.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Streaming is consolidating into fewer, larger services.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The board pointed to the size of global rivals.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: It is backed by Comcast and Paramount Skydance.

stories.background: SkyShowtime launched in 2022 in Central and Eastern Europe, Scandinavia and parts of Western Europe.

meme.take: SkyShowtime is closing because it was too small, which is a lesson its owners already knew.

stories.title: World of Warcraft: Forever reaches 15 million players
stories.summary: Blizzard's World of Warcraft: Forever has more weekly players than WoW has seen in 15 years, its lead says, as it passes 15 million players.
stories.why: A two-decade-old game drawing record crowds shows how strong nostalgia is in gaming.
stories.happened: Blizzard has also banned players exploiting a gold glitch, including a well-known streamer, GamesRadar reports.
stories.next: Watch for Blizzard's plans to keep new and returning players around.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Many returning players first played WoW years ago.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It has passed 15 million players.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: A ban wave hit gold exploiters, including a big streamer.

stories.background: World of Warcraft launched in 2004 and is one of the most successful online games ever. Blizzard is owned by Microsoft.

meme.take: World of Warcraft is having its best year since its players had fewer bills.

stories.title: Alibaba's AI cloud revenue jumps 53% as profit triples
stories.summary: Alibaba's AI cloud and computing revenue rose 53% and quarterly net profit roughly tripled, the WSJ and MarketWatch report.
stories.why: Alibaba is China's biggest cloud provider, so its results are a gauge of AI demand outside the US.
stories.happened: Total revenue rose 10% to about $40.7 billion, the WSJ reports. Revenue from external AI cloud customers rose 64%. Its AI labs, including the Qwen team, still posted adjusted operating losses of about 10.5 billion yuan.
stories.next: Watch for Alibaba's next Qwen model releases and its AI spending plans.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Net profit roughly tripled, the WSJ reports.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI is driving cloud growth worldwide.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Its Qwen models compete with US open-weight models.

stories.background: Alibaba is a Chinese e-commerce and cloud company. Qwen is its family of AI models.

meme.take: Alibaba has found the AI business model: sell the shovels to everyone, including yourself.

stories.title: Nvidia is said to be near a deal for diffusion AI startup Inception
stories.summary: The Information reports Nvidia is in advanced talks to buy Inception, maker of Mercury diffusion language models, for over $500 million plus earnouts.
stories.why: Diffusion models write text in parallel rather than word by word, which could make AI much faster.
stories.happened: Talks reportedly began before Jensen Huang's resignation as CEO. Mercury is said to generate over 1,000 tokens per second, and Inception's current API is scheduled to shut down on December 28.
stories.next: Watch for an official announcement and what happens to Mercury's customers.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The reported price is over $500 million plus earnouts.

drivers.label: Speed
drivers.text: Mercury is said to produce over 1,000 tokens a second.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Nvidia is under an interim CEO.

stories.background: Nvidia designs the GPUs used to train and run most AI models.

meme.bottom: now it wants the faster words too
meme.take: Nvidia goes shopping for a startup, the calmest thing it has done all month.

stories.title: A bill for a federal film and TV tax credit gains dozens of backers
stories.summary: Twelve more senators and over 70 House members signed on to a bill that would create a federal tax credit for film and TV production.
stories.why: Productions have been leaving California and the US for places with bigger incentives.
stories.happened: The Motion Picture, Television and Entertainment Revitalization Act has over 200 supporting organizations, TheWrap reports. The new co-sponsors signed on on November 19. The bill has not yet passed either chamber.
stories.next: Watch for whether the bill gets a committee vote before the year ends.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Tax credits decide where many films and shows are shot.

drivers.label: Momentum
drivers.text: Dozens of lawmakers signed on in one day.

drivers.label: Jobs
drivers.text: Hollywood crews have struggled with production moving abroad.

stories.background: Many US states and countries such as the UK and Canada already offer tax incentives for production.

meme.take: Congress finally found a film everyone in it wants to produce.

stories.title: Rockstar says the PS5 Pro is not powerful enough for GTA VI at 60fps
stories.summary: GTA VI runs at 30 frames per second on consoles, and Rockstar says even the PS5 Pro cannot handle its simulation at 60.
stories.why: Most big console games now offer a 60fps mode, so fans are debating the trade-off.
stories.happened: Digital Foundry says the PS5 Pro version looks significantly better at the same frame rate. Some PS5 players have also hit an error, CE-108255-1, and Sony required an update to play.
stories.next: Watch for patches and whether the PC version offers higher frame rates.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Frame rate is a hot topic for console players.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Sony sells the PS5 Pro as its most powerful console.

drivers.label: Hardware
drivers.text: It shows the limits of current consoles.

stories.background: The PS5 Pro is Sony's upgraded PlayStation 5, released in 2024.

meme.take: GTA VI runs at 30fps on the PS5 Pro, so the Pro now mostly refers to the price.

stories.title: Meta's Muse Charm AI device is said to cost $300 with free 5G
stories.summary: The Information reports Meta's portable Muse Charm will cost $300 and include up to 12 months of free Verizon 5G data.
stories.why: Meta is trying to build AI hardware beyond its glasses, a market where others have struggled.
stories.happened: Gizmodo reports it could arrive around the December holidays. The news lands while Meta's Muse assistant faces reports of privacy problems.
stories.next: Watch for an official launch date and what the device can do offline.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: A $300 price with free data is an aggressive offer.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It is reportedly aimed at the holidays.

drivers.label: Risk
drivers.text: Muse is facing privacy questions.

stories.background: Meta also sells Ray-Ban smart glasses with its AI assistant built in.

meme.bottom: for an assistant with a reputation
meme.take: Meta's new device comes with a year of free data, in both directions.

stories.title: Google opens its Genie 4 world model to developers through the Gemini API
stories.summary: Genie 4 is now in the Gemini API, creating interactive 720p worlds at 24 frames per second with native audio and keyboard controls.
stories.why: World models that respond to input could be used to make games, simulations and training grounds for robots.
stories.happened: Developers can change environments with text prompts while exploring. Genie 4 reached Google's AI Ultra subscribers earlier this week through Project Genie, which adds a world-building agent and a sharing gallery.
stories.next: Watch for the first games and tools developers build on the API.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: World models are a fast-growing area of AI research.

drivers.label: Access
drivers.text: The model moved from subscribers to developers within days.

drivers.label: Gaming
drivers.text: Playable generated worlds are a step toward AI-made games.

stories.background: Google DeepMind is Google's AI research lab. AI Ultra is Google's top AI subscription.

meme.bottom: get a world that runs at 24 fps
meme.take: Genie builds a whole world on request, which is faster than most game studios manage.

stories.title: Sony misses a Game Awards GOTY nomination for the first time in 12 years
stories.summary: None of Marvel's Wolverine, Saros or Marathon made The Game Awards' Game of the Year list, ending Sony's 12-year run of nominations.
stories.why: Sony's studios have long been awards favourites, so the gap is a talking point for PlayStation fans.
stories.happened: GamesRadar also reports Palworld's lead called Crimson Desert's snubs a terrible shame. GTA VI leads the field with eight nominations.
stories.next: Watch for the winners at The Game Awards in December.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Sony has been a fixture in the top category.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Wolverine was one of PlayStation's biggest releases.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: Other snubs, like Crimson Desert, are also being debated.

stories.background: The Game Awards is an annual show hosted by Geoff Keighley, held each December.

meme.bottom: and the shortlist still had no claws
meme.take: After 12 years at the top table, PlayStation is watching The Game Awards like the rest of us.

stories.title: Nvidia stops shipping H200 chips to China after a $115.8 billion quarter
stories.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress said Nvidia plans no further licensed H200 shipments to China, after revenue more than doubled to $115.8 billion.
stories.why: China was once a major market for Nvidia, and US and Chinese rules keep squeezing it.
stories.happened: Revenue rose 103% and data center revenue reached $107.6 billion. Nvidia guided to about $130 billion next quarter, excluding China data center sales. Chinese restrictions and domestic competition are cited.
stories.next: Watch for how Nvidia's China plans come up in the California and congressional inquiries.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: Quarterly revenue more than doubled.

drivers.label: Rules
drivers.text: Both US and Chinese policies limit sales.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It is Nvidia's first quarter report without Jensen Huang as CEO.

stories.background: Nvidia designs the GPUs used to train and run most AI models. Kress has been its CFO since 2013.

meme.bottom: and the forecast still had a gap
meme.take: Nvidia made $115.8 billion in a quarter and still had to leave one country off the slide.

stories.title: Moonshot AI reportedly scraps a $150 million Nvidia chip deal in Indonesia
stories.summary: China's Moonshot AI cancelled a $150 million deal to use Nvidia chips at an Indonesian data center, The Information reports.
stories.why: It shows US chip rules now reach Chinese firms renting computers abroad, not just buying chips.
stories.happened: The cancellation reportedly followed new US rules limiting remote access to advanced chips by Chinese firms. Bloomberg separately reports UK cloud firm Nscale now needs a US license to give ByteDance access to Nvidia GPUs.
stories.next: Watch for more Chinese AI labs changing overseas compute deals.

drivers.label: Rules
drivers.text: New US limits cover remote access to chips, not just exports.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: US and Chinese AI labs are competing for computing power.

drivers.label: Money
drivers.text: The deal was reportedly worth $150 million.

stories.background: Moonshot AI is a Beijing startup known for its Kimi chatbot.

meme.take: Moonshot discovered the US export rules also have a section on borrowing.

stories.title: Stallone biopic I Play Rocky goes nationwide with a $15 million to $20 million forecast
stories.summary: Amazon MGM's I Play Rocky expands this weekend after earning nearly $1 million on fewer than 30 screens, with strong reviews.
stories.why: A crowd-pleasing film about making Rocky could become counter-programming to the Hunger Games prequel.
stories.happened: BoxOfficePro reports an 87% critic score and a 98% audience score. Peter Farrelly directs, with Anthony Ippolito as Sylvester Stallone fighting to get Rocky made.
stories.next: Watch for its weekend total and whether word of mouth carries it through the holidays.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Rocky is one of cinema's best-known underdog stories.

drivers.label: Word of mouth
drivers.text: Its audience score is 98%.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It opens wide against the Hunger Games prequel.

stories.background: Rocky (1976) was written by and starred Sylvester Stallone and won the Oscar for best picture.

meme.take: I Play Rocky has picked the one weekend that makes its own plot look easy.

stories.title: Paramount and Warner Bros. TV studios are being combined into one
stories.summary: Skydance plans to combine Paramount Television Studios and Warner Bros. Television Group into Warner Bros. Television Studios, Cynopsis reports.
stories.why: Merging two of TV's biggest studios changes who makes many of the shows people watch.
stories.happened: The plan was announced on November 18. It follows Paramount Skydance's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery.
stories.next: Watch for leadership names and whether any shows or staff are cut.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: The merged studio joins two large TV production houses.

drivers.label: Consolidation
drivers.text: It follows Paramount Skydance's takeover of Warner Bros. Discovery.

drivers.label: Jobs
drivers.text: Studio mergers usually bring restructuring.

stories.background: Warner Bros. Television makes shows for many networks and streamers. Paramount Skydance formed in 2025.

meme.top: Two TV studios walk into a merger
meme.take: Hollywood's crossover event of the year has no cast, just an org chart.

stories.title: Deltarune Chapter 6 is structurally complete as work begins on Chapter 7
stories.summary: Toby Fox says Deltarune Chapter 6 is now structurally complete and the team has begun on Chapter 7.
stories.why: Deltarune has a huge, patient fan base that follows every development update.
stories.happened: Fox told fans he feels he knows what he is doing this time, GamesRadar reports. No release date for Chapter 6 was given.
stories.next: Watch for a release window for Chapter 6.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Deltarune updates draw large fan attention.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Toby Fox made the cult hit Undertale.

drivers.label: Progress
drivers.text: Two chapters are now in development at once.

stories.background: Deltarune is Toby Fox's follow-up to Undertale, released in chapters since 2018.

meme.bottom: which fans will read as tomorrow
meme.take: Toby Fox shares a progress update, and the fan base starts a countdown with no end date.

stories.title: HBO renews The Gilded Age for a fifth season
stories.summary: HBO has renewed Julian Fellowes' period drama The Gilded Age for a fifth season, with its fourth season the show's most watched yet.
stories.why: Lavish period dramas remain one of the few genres that keep audiences coming back week after week.
stories.happened: Season 4 premiered on November 1 and its finale is on December 20. The show has 15 Emmy nominations to date, including for Outstanding Drama Series, Programming Insider reports.
stories.next: Watch for a production start date and any casting news for season 5.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Season 4 is the most watched so far, Cynopsis says.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Julian Fellowes created Downton Abbey.

drivers.label: Awards
drivers.text: The show has 15 Emmy nominations.

stories.background: The Gilded Age is set among New York's wealthy families in the 1880s.

meme.take: The Gilded Age is renewed again, proving inherited wealth is also a business model for TV.

stories.title: Samsung reshuffles its chip and mobile leaders
stories.summary: Samsung named new heads for its memory, System LSI and mobile businesses, with Won-Joon Choi taking over mobile from TM Roh.
stories.why: Samsung's memory chips are central to AI hardware, and leadership changes signal where it is betting.
stories.happened: Sang Joon Hwang becomes president and head of memory, Sangyeun Cho leads System LSI and Jong Myeong Lee becomes CTO of Device Solutions. TM Roh stays co-CEO, 9to5Google reports.
stories.next: Watch for Samsung's next Galaxy launch under its new mobile chief.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Samsung is one of the world's largest memory makers.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: AI demand has made memory chips scarce and costly.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: The changes come ahead of its next phone launches.

stories.background: Samsung Electronics is South Korea's largest company and makes Galaxy phones and memory chips.

meme.top: Memory chips are the hot item
meme.take: Samsung shuffles its leaders, a rare part of the company not affected by memory shortages.

stories.title: Sky says Love Island will stay free as UK regulators review its ITV deal
stories.summary: Sky's deal to acquire ITV assets is under review by Ofcom and the CMA, and Sky says Love Island and Coronation Street will remain free-to-air.
stories.why: ITV is one of Britain's main free channels, so putting it under a pay-TV owner worries viewers.
stories.happened: Sky Group COO Nick Herm said the big ITV shows stay free. Sky Studios head Cécile Frot-Coutaz suggested The Day of the Jackal could move from Sky's paywall to ITV. The deal is not complete.
stories.next: Watch for the regulators' decisions on competition and media plurality.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: It would combine Britain's biggest pay-TV and commercial broadcasters.

drivers.label: Regulation
drivers.text: Two UK regulators are reviewing it.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Love Island and Coronation Street are among ITV's biggest shows.

stories.background: Sky is owned by Comcast. ITV is the UK's largest commercial free-to-air broadcaster.

meme.bottom: but promises Love Island stays single
meme.take: Sky's pitch to regulators is that nothing will change, except the owner.

stories.title: Slay the Spire 2 nears 8 million copies sold, an analyst says
stories.summary: An analyst estimates Slay the Spire 2 has sold nearly 8 million copies and uses play data to argue its fans are unusually devoted.
stories.why: It is a huge number for an indie card game and shows small teams can still compete with blockbusters.
stories.happened: The figure is an analyst estimate rather than an official number from developer Mega Crit, GamesRadar reports.
stories.next: Watch for an official sales figure from Mega Crit.

drivers.label: Scale
drivers.text: Nearly 8 million copies is blockbuster territory for an indie game.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Players are said to be playing it obsessively.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Roguelike deck-builders keep growing.

stories.background: Slay the Spire is a roguelike deck-building game by Seattle studio Mega Crit. The first game came out in 2019.

meme.take: Slay the Spire 2 has nearly 8 million owners and no one has gone to bed on time since.

stories.title: Shift Up says Stellar Blade: Blood Rain is handmade after AI video backlash
stories.summary: After backlash over an AI-made music video, Shift Up's boss said Stellar Blade: Blood Rain is handmade, while noting its developers still use AI.
stories.why: Players are increasingly sensitive to generative AI in games and their marketing.
stories.happened: GamesRadar reports the studio head distinguished the game itself from AI use in development. In the same week, Resident Evil creator Shinji Mikami said he wishes generative AI would vanish but still uses it.
stories.next: Watch for more studios spelling out how they use AI.

drivers.label: Controversy
drivers.text: An AI-made music video drew criticism.

drivers.label: Trend
drivers.text: Generative AI use is a hot topic across games.

drivers.label: Fan demand
drivers.text: Stellar Blade sold well on PS5.

stories.background: Shift Up is a South Korean studio. Stellar Blade launched on PS5 in 2024.

meme.bottom: the hands just have some help
meme.take: Shift Up clarifies the game is handmade, in the same way a cake from a mix is homemade.

stories.title: Ebenezer is forecast to drop to third in its second weekend
stories.summary: Johnny Depp's Ebenezer is forecast at $8 million to $13 million in weekend two, as the Hunger Games prequel arrives.
stories.why: It tests whether a dark take on a holiday classic can hold up through the season.
stories.happened: The Ti West film opened at No. 1 with $19 million in the US, slightly under expectations, BoxOfficePro says. It has an A- CinemaScore and 53% on Rotten Tomatoes.
stories.next: Watch for its hold over Thanksgiving week.

drivers.label: Big name
drivers.text: Johnny Depp plays the lead.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: Christmas stories usually play through December.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: It faces the Hunger Games and I Play Rocky this weekend.

stories.background: Ebenezer is a new take on Charles Dickens' A Christmas Carol.

meme.take: Scrooge has faced ghosts before, but never a franchise opening weekend.

stories.title: Gilmore Girls: A Year in the Life moves from Netflix to Hulu and Disney+
stories.summary: The 2016 Gilmore Girls revival leaves Netflix and arrives on Hulu and Disney+ on December 25, Cynopsis reports.
stories.why: Comfort rewatches are prized by streamers, and fans now have to follow the show to a new service.
stories.happened: A Year in the Life was made as a Netflix revival of the original series. The move lands on Christmas Day, a busy time for cosy viewing.
stories.next: Watch for whether the original seasons follow it.

drivers.label: Nostalgia
drivers.text: Gilmore Girls remains a popular comfort rewatch.

drivers.label: Rivalry
drivers.text: Streamers compete for well-loved older shows.

drivers.label: Timing
drivers.text: It moves on Christmas Day.

stories.background: Gilmore Girls ran from 2000 to 2007 and follows a mother and daughter in a small Connecticut town.

meme.take: Gilmore Girls changes streamers for Christmas, which is very on brand for a family drama.
